piso_garantizado.evidencia: Never denial of basic ration, water or urgent medical care.

adicional_por_aporte.evidencia: surplus is distributed proportionally to work

otro_criterio_de_reparto.evidencia: Whoever leaves takes personal effects and a fair share of stored food

trabajo_segun_capacidad.evidencia: Everyone contributes work according to capacity and receives a full basic ration
